about.title: About Me
about.p1: Senior Software Engineer working in the industry since 2018, with a bachelor's in Computer Science and postgraduate degrees in Full-Stack Development and Applied AI Engineering. I build scalable distributed systems and high-performance applications that deliver business value.
about.p2: I've built Appointally's 26-service platform, contributed to WMS serving 200+ distribution centers, and developed B2B commerce and reusable UI libraries at AmbevTech. I combine backend and frontend engineering with RAG, LLM integration, and AI-assisted development. I speak native Brazilian Portuguese and English at C1 level.
